headline: Smoother frame pacing, controller fixes and fewer crashes on develop
summary: The development branch gained smoother frame limiting and fixes for controllers connected through docks or switched during play. Ratchet & Clank fixes cover the PAL flight to Quartu, a Blarg Station landing crash with extra enemies, missing menu text and HUD elements. Larger modded maps and work-in-progress enhanced lighting preparation also landed.
highlights: More precise waits improve frame pacing with the frame limiter (#146).
Controllers take priority when first pressed, addressing dock devices occupying the first controller slot (#149).
PAL flights from Kalebo to Quartu now finish loading; Blarg Station landings skip missing actors when the actor pool is full (#151, #147).
Menu text with anti-aliasing on Intel Arc and panel flicker without it on Adreno received fixes (#145, #157).
Modded maps gain larger memory and object capacities; a follow-up preserves the original class-slot limit in ordinary sessions (#148, #158).
Enhanced rendering gains native lighting preparation, compressed probes and water material work, described as work in progress (#154).
